testCase.name: [local] S20 Local pre-QA host check: the browser talks only to the app and its local backend

descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S20 Local pre-QA host check: the browser talks only to the app and its local backend

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES). (UAT OAT-02; TFA-92568 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Local stack (web http://localhost:6473, Convex http://127.0.0.1:4510/4511) and the fixture patients

When The agent walks both lists, each chart tab in both modes, types a line into the Encounter notes box, opens Ask AI on a preset, and opens Handoff and the task review. The run records every request's scheme and host. Opening Handoff makes one handoff-summary AI call per In Today resident on the local stack.

Then There is no request to any host outside the app origin and the local Convex backend (this walk never dictates, so api.openai.com is not allowed), and no non-local host is reached over http: or ws:

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Network log against an allowlist: an unknown host, or a non-local host over http/ws, is a finding. The local origin and backend are plain HTTP by design (UAT 4: not the acceptance environment), so this run is pre-QA evidence and never a Pass for U1.

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: probes.

UAT item: OAT-02 Encryption Verification · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-02/S20

Local pre-QA host check: the browser talks only to the app and its local backend

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress)

New local lane probes: status record-only in probes/results.json → needs a person (record only, no cell was judged → a person looks).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): Scripted walk (both lists, all chart tabs both modes, typed line, one Ask AI preset (live), Handoff, task review, NH Handoff (live summary)) recording every request and WebSocket origin; anything outside localhost:6473 / 127.0.0.1:4510 / 4511 is a finding. [Review 2026-10-14] Result is record-only (pre-QA): 0 judged cells, never a Pass for U1 on the plain-HTTP local stack. — network-capture is context.on('request') + page.on('websocket'). Pre-QA evidence only (UAT 4): never a Pass for U1.

Detail:

Pre-QA evidence only, not decidable here: the local stack is plain HTTP by design, so this run is never a Pass for U1 (UAT 4); a person decides U1 on the HTTPS acceptance build. Recorded: 1,512 requests over the walk (both lists, all tabs both modes, typed line, Ask AI preset 'What were today's labs?', Handoff, task review, NH Handoff): only localhost:6473 (http, ws = Vite HMR), 127.0.0.1:4510 (ws) and 127.0.0.1:4511 (http); no other host, no non-local http/ws.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — A local pre-QA host check by design: the title, the given and networkCheck.allowedHosts name the local stack, and the oracle says it never counts toward U1.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
